item.title: Reynard v0.13.1
item.description:
Reynard 0.13.1 | Reynard
## Changes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.13.0...0.13.1
This is a minor release that addresses issues found in 0.13.0. For the full changelog, see the [0.13.0 release notes](https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/releases/tag/0.13.0).
### Bug Fixes & Improvements - Improved the reliability of text input fields repositioning above the software keyboard when editing. - Fixed issues with the new toolbar minimizing behavior introduced in 0.13.0, including mistaken taps, misaligned page elements, and out-of-place sticky headers and menus, along with better behavior when resizing or zooming.
